description: Python script for encoding MOXA firmware files, including adding headers, CRC calculation, and encryption.

classes.name: Partition
classes.description: Data class representing a firmware partition with name and size.

methods.name: xor
methods.description: Performs XOR encryption/decryption on data using a passphrase.

methods.name: add_fw_header
methods.description: Adds a firmware header to the data with specified parameters.

methods.name: add_file_header
methods.description: Adds a file header with filename and build ID to the data.

methods.name: crc
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum with initial value.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that processes firmware partitions, adds headers, encrypts, and writes output.
